articles.summary: 11/16/2026 LEXINGTON, Mass., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapid Micro Biosystems, Inc. (Nasdaq: RPID) (the “Company”), an innovative life sciences technology company providing mission-critical automation solutions to facilitate the efficient manufacturing and fast, safe release of healthcare products, today announced it has signed a definitive agreement pursuant to which Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, has agreed to acquire, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the agreement, all outstanding shares of Rapid Micro Biosystems at a price of $0.75 per share in an all-cash transaction. "Over the past 18 months, we have built a strong partnership with Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, centered on a shared commitment to innovation and helping customers modernize and automate their quality-control workflows,” said Robert Spignesi, President and CEO of Rapid Micro Biosystems. “Rapid Micro has established the Growth Direct platform as the leading solution for automating microbial quality control, with most of the world's top pharmaceutical manufacturers as customers. We are confident that joining the Life Science business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany will significantly expand the Growth Direct platform’s reach and more fully serve our combined global customer base." “Quality control is essential to the reliable manufacture of medicines,” said Paolo Carli, Head of Advanced Solutions for the Life Science business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany. “Our customers need reliable results faster, more efficient quality-control workflows and robust data integrity to support regulatory compliance. Rapid Micro Biosystems will strengthen our ability to meet those needs, building on our existing offering and bringing greater automation to a critical step in pharmaceutical manufacturing.” Transaction Details The transaction is expected to close in December 2026, subject to the successful completion of the tender offer, including satisfaction of the minimum tender condition, and other customary closing conditions. Following completion of the transaction, Rapid Micro Biosystems will become part of the Life Science business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany. Advisors Perella Weinberg Partners is serving as financial advisor to the Company and Goodwin Procter LLP is serving as legal counsel. About Rapid Micro Biosystems Rapid Micro Biosystems is an innovative life sciences technology company providing mission-critical automation solutions to facilitate the efficient manufacturing and fast, safe release of healthcare products such as biologics, vaccines, cell and gene therapies, and sterile injectables. The Company’s flagship Growth Direct system automates and modernizes the antiquated, manual microbial quality control (“MQC”) testing workflows used in the largest and most complex pharmaceutical manufacturing operations across the globe. The Growth Direct system brings the quality control lab to the manufacturing floor, unlocking the power of MQC automation to deliver the faster results, greater accuracy, increased operational efficiency, better compliance with data integrity regulations, and quicker decision making that customers rely on to ensure safe and consistent supply of important healthcare products. The Company is headquartered in Lexington, Massachusetts and has U.S. manufacturing in Lowell, Massachusetts, with global locations in Switzerland, Germany, and the Netherlands. For more information, please visit www.rapidmicrobio.com or follow the Company on X (formerly known as Twitter) at @rapidmicrobio or on LinkedIn. Rapid Micro Biosystems intends to use the Investor Relations page of its website as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Accordingly, investors should monitor its website in addition to following press releases, filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”), public conference calls, presentations and webcasts. Additional Information and Where to Find It The tender offer described in this communication has not yet commenced, and this communication is neither an offer to purchase nor a solicitation of an offer to sell securities. (“Purchaser”) will file a tender offer statement on Schedule TO with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”), and Rapid Micro Biosystems (“Rapid”) will file a solicitation/recommendation statement on Schedule 14D-9 with the SEC. articles.summary: With Mastercard Accept issuers can extend everyday acceptance capabilities to debit and prepaid cardholders through existing banking channels and experiences. Whether you're a street food vendor in Asia, selling homemade crafts at a market in Latin America, earning extra income for tutoring in Africa, or selling a second-hand bicycle through an online marketplace in the Middle East. Whether collecting payment for goods and services or turning a personal skill into a side hustle: How do you get paid? Worldwide, this question matters to the people who earn income through informal work and independent services, many of whom still rely on cash. Sharing personal details or navigating unfamiliar payment services and platforms to get paid can be daunting. As our lives evolve, and people move between shopping, selling, earning and sending money daily, the way we get paid must evolve
articles.title: Mastercard Enables Debit Cardholders to Get Paid as Easily as They Pay
